scope: Read-only structural diagnosis of a bounded copied Data journal. No replay implementation, filesystem access decision, or inspection acceptance change.

sources.retrieval: Independently fetched complete UTF-8 files via read-only GitHub connector at the exact commit, verified returned Git blob identities and ASCII byte lengths; inspected definitions, producer and consumer code.

verified_semantics.fact: Current block-list prefix is16bytes; packed block_info entries are16bytes. The fourth prefix word is flags, not required-zero padding.
Flag0x1 enables payload checksums; flag0x2 marks a first block-list header.
num_blocks includes reserved entry0. Data descriptors are indices1 through num_blocks-1. Capacity is blhdr_size/16-1;49152-byte headers have capacity3071.

The block-list checksum covers the original first32bytes with its checksum word zero. Entry0 carries the sequence value at its lastu32; its bnum can hold an opaque chain pointer and must never be followed or exported by this diagnostic.
Payload checksums are distinct from header checksums. Upstream checks nonzero stored payload checksums when flag0x1 applies. A storedzero is not an independently validated payload checksum.
Killed entries use signed bnum=-1. Their payload sizes still advance the ring, but their targets are skipped. Other negative bnum values are rejected.
A list occupies its complete block-list header plus all described payload lengths. Circular reads wrap to jhdr_size, never offset0. Only the header-declared active interval is in scope.
Upstream sequence checks permit equality or the next value when both values are nonzero. Flags and sequence fields are current format facts; the archived next-field prose cannot substitute for them.

archived_TN1150_caveat.issue: The2004 note conflicts with itself: its num_blocks definition includes entry0, while nearby array/inclusive-loop prose says one more. It also calls the modern flags field padding and describes an older next field.
archived_TN1150_caveat.resolution: Use the pinned current definitions and matching producer/consumer loops for flags, entry count and sequence interpretation. TN1150 remains useful for ring bounds, inactive-region exclusion and sector-relative target meaning.

implementation_review_requirements: Verify exact input size/source pins and current header/JIB geometry before parsing.
Bound all counts, lengths, allocations, iterations and circular slices to the declared active region; check descriptor table and aggregate payload lengths.
Treat unknown flags, unsupported layouts and unavailable checksum evidence explicitly. Do not equate a diagnostic refusal with demonstrated filesystem corruption.
Do not follow opaque entry0 pointer values or read target blocks. Export only bounded scalar or aggregate metadata; no payload or file inventories.
Preserve all actual receipt/absence/lock/source/image/tool identity checks and owned-child cleanup in the separate host wrapper.
Keep structural observations separate from filesystem health, replay safety, both-fsck gates and overall inspection acceptance.
